messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — pulled onboarding feedback from three pilot customers, there's a recurring theme around: per-route toggle discoverability, unclear cost estimates, and request for team-level API keys.
Maya: short quotes: "Couldn't find per-route billing toggle — blocked setup" (CityHealth), "We need sample cost per 100k tokens for evals" (Summit), "Can we get team API keys + RBAC?" (Helio)
Liam: thanks — can you paste the raw excerpts and how many accounts hit each issue? want to log as product signals.
Maya: pasted above, counts: CityHealth (1 paying, renewal in Q2), Summit (pilot, 3 teams), Helio (trial, asking security).
Anika: noted. For the per-route toggle UX — SE question: is this the same console page as route-level settings? if yes, we can add a tooltip + move the toggle higher in the DOM as a low-effort fix.
Anika: mock plan: add a contextual tooltip that explains billing impact and a direct link to cost-preview. 1 day UX + 1 day small frontend change.
Raj: prioritization ask: which of these customers are at renewal risk if we don't act? Maya: CityHealth high risk (Q2 renewal), Summit medium (pilot could convert), Helio low but could stall.
Liam: sounds like tooltip + cost-preview could be a quick win. I'll scope dev effort — if Anika's estimate holds, put it P2 and try for a canary next week.
Maya: I'll own comms — reach out with a short note explaining console update and how it helps onboarding. Will include suggested wording for CSMs.
Liam: can we also provide a sample cost table (per 10k / 100k tokens) in the docs? Ops/finance will need numbers.
Maya: yes — I'll ask billing team for a simple matrix and paste it here when available.
Anika: for API keys request: that sounds like a larger product change (RBAC + team keys). recommend we log it as a backlog item and surface to roadmap planning.
Liam: agree — backlog this under 'account-security' and 'api-ux'. We'll triage during roadmap sync.
Ezra-bot: INF-2147 created: "Onboarding: per-route toggle discoverability + cost-preview tooltip" assigned to Anika, priority P2, due 3d.
Anika: picking up INF-2147. Will post mock by EOD tomorrow.
Raj: I'll draft an enablement short-runbook and two email templates: one for paying customers (CityHealth style) and one for pilots. ETA: 48hrs.
Maya: perfect. tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, api-keys-request.
Liam: can someone add a quick note to the renewal tracker for CityHealth and mark it as "blocking: onboarding confusion"?
Maya: done — marked in tracker and assigned follow-up to me.
Raj: once Anika shares mock, I'll update the playbook with screenshots.
Maya: thanks team — small fixes here could materially move renewal outcomes. Ping if you need raw transcripts or more quotes. :raised_hands:
